programme.title: Miss Kobayashi's Dragon Maid S Ep5
programme.desc: Tohru and Elma start fighting when they see each other in the shopping district. It wasn't always like this. The story of how they first met goes back a long time in the other world.

programme.title: The Dangers in My Heart Ep2
programme.desc: Yamada invites Ichikawa to her home for the first time. Nervous while bathing, Ichikawa realizes that he forgot his underwear. While trying to retrieve it, he sees Yamada in loungewear!?

programme.title: The Dangers in My Heart Ep3
programme.desc: Ichikawa and the girls are having a sweets-making party at Yamada's house. Yamada's mother is suspicious of a Ichikawa's presence. Sekina and Ichikawa act as couple, but Yamada feels uneasy...

programme.title: Ensemble Stars! Ep1
programme.desc: Yumenosaki Private Academy specializes in producing male idols. Idol students Subaru Akehoshi, Hokuto Hidaka, Makoto Yuki and Mao Isara begins the testing-phase 'Produce Course'.

programme.title: Ensemble Stars! Ep2
programme.desc: While Trickstar plan their revolution in secret, Rei Sakuma, one of the 'three oddballs' proposes to provide support. Meanwhile, the DreamFes 'S2' between Ra*bits and AKATSUKI begins...

programme.title: Ensemble Stars! Ep3
programme.desc: Yumenosaki Academy falls deeper into the student council's control. The members of Trickstar conclude their individual training and prepares for the 'S1' against AKATSUKI as a group.

programme.title: Ensemble Stars! Ep4
programme.desc: On stage, UNDEAD launches their surprise attack at AKATSUKI, followed by 2wink's performance. Amidst the battlefield, Trickstar make their appearance. What will be the battle outcome...?

programme.title: Ensemble Stars! Ep5
programme.desc: After S1, Nazuna of Ra*bits learns that Eichi is discharged from the hospital and starts recollecting the happenings over the past year, when he was still a member of Valkyrie...

programme.title: Ensemble Stars! Ep6
programme.desc: Last Fall, Yumenosaki Academy fell under the student council's control after they introduced the Dreamfes system. As a result of avoiding live showdowns, Valkyrie fell from their top spot.

programme.title: Ensemble Stars! Ep7
programme.desc: Trickstar is called out by the student council. Their president Eichi Tenshouin demands the disbandment of Trickstar and orders the transfer of each member to a different idol unit...

programme.title: Ensemble Stars! Ep7
programme.desc: Trickstar is called out by the student council. Their president Eichi Tenshouin demands the disbandment of Trickstar and orders the transfer of each member to a different idol unit...

programme.title: Ensemble Stars! Ep8
programme.desc: Trickstar is now broken apart and as Subaru stumbles over his reason for becoming an idol, RYUSEITAI, led by Chiaki Morisawa, appears before him...

programme.title: Ensemble Stars! Ep9
programme.desc: The DDD commences as the Yumenosaki idols compete to represent the academy at the SS. Meanwhile, Subaru is on his way to rescue Makoto, who has been confined by Izumi Sena of Knights...

programme.title: Ensemble Stars! Ep10
programme.desc: Trickstar aims for the DDD with three members-Subaru, Makoto and Mao. Eichi and Keito are trying to carry out a plan after electing the 'Five Oddballs' who would represent the academy.

programme.title: Ensemble Stars! Ep11
programme.desc: To fight against the Five Eccentrics, Eichi's new idol unit 'fine' commences their activities. Under the new DreamFes system, they steadily gain popularity...

programme.title: Ensemble Stars! Ep12
programme.desc: The second match of the DDD semifinals begins. Led by Eichi, fine takes on UNDEAD which is led by Rei. As Eichi makes his resolve, Trickstar makes their appearance on stage...

programme.title: PUELLA MAGI MADOKA MAGICA SIDE STORY MAGIA RECORD 2nd SEASON -The Eve of Awakening- Ep4
programme.desc: Kuroe brings Iroha and Yachiyo to Hotel Fendt Hope, where they run into the Amane sisters. Iroha and Kuroe head towards Nemu's quarters but are stopped by Black Wings Rena and Kaede.

programme.title: PUELLA MAGI MADOKA MAGICA SIDE STORY MAGIA RECORD 2nd SEASON -The Eve of Awakening- Ep5
programme.desc: Kuroe accompanies Iroha to search for her friends from the Mikazuki Dorm. The feelings of the girls who serve the Magius grow complicated as Toka reveals a plan to save all magical girls...

programme.title: Sacrificial Princess and the King of Beasts Ep11
programme.desc: Anubis declares Sariphi as the queen's representative. Sariphi's presence is made known to the greater public and thus, incurs backlash. Watching the events unfold, Amit decides to cheer Sariphi up.

programme.title: Sacrificial Princess and the King of Beasts Ep12
programme.desc: Sariphi struggles with her first task as the queen's representative due to the Queen of Sabre, Karkala's interference. Just then, the Fourth Princess, Tetra, appears with a solution.

programme.title: Tune in to the Midnight Heart Ep5
programme.desc: Shinobu is planning a 'Confession Relay' for the sports festival. But distributing flyers to publicize the event is tedious, so Nene comes up with an albeit embarrassing idea.

programme.title: Tune in to the Midnight Heart Ep6
programme.desc: The broadcasting club members celebrate the success of sports day with a party at Lemon's house. Iko calls out to sleeping Arisu, wondering why he was hugging Shinobu during the festival

programme.title: The Cold Sato-san Is Only Sweet to Me Ep7
programme.desc: After an accident reveals her in her swimsuit, Sato runs away. Rinka and Shizuku try to cheer up Oshio. Meanwhile, Madoka gives Sato some blunt but honest words. Encouraged, Sato tries to head back but...

programme.title: The Cold Sato-san Is Only Sweet to Me Ep8
programme.desc: Koharu Sato is known as the 'cold school beauty.' At his family's cafe, Sota discovers an unexpectedly endearing side to Sato. On top of that, it turns out the two have a mutual crush on each other!?

programme.title: NISEKOI Ep7
programme.desc: Kosaki's sister, Haru finds herself surrounded by delinquents. Before she passes out from terror, she sees a boy wearing the uniform of her own school, coming to save her.

programme.title: NISEKOI Ep8
programme.desc: Kosaki becomes a magical girl. One day, two magical girls from the neighbouring town arrive and they team up to defeat evil. Raku has been asked to help at Onodera's sweet shop.

programme.title: NISEKOI Ep9
programme.desc: Raku and the others are tasked with cleaning the pool. They change into their swimsuits and get to work, but all Paula does is watch them from afar? Raku visits a sick Kosaki and seees Haru there.

programme.title: NISEKOI Ep10
programme.desc: Raku's best friend, Shu, has a cheerful personality and is a goofball. Though he seems oblivious to romance, Raku finds out he's in love with someone! Who is this crush?

programme.title: Attack on Titan Final Season Part 2 Ep18
programme.desc: The Beast Titan joins the fray, but General Magath is determined to take him down. Meanwhile, with the city in flames, Colt and Gabi rush to rescue Falco who's held captive by the Jaegerists.

programme.title: Attack on Titan Final Season Part 2 Ep19
programme.desc: Colt pleads with Zeke to not use his scream and turn Falco into a Titan. All the while, soldiers and Titans clash in battle as Eren struggles to make contact with his brother.

programme.title: Attack on Titan Final Season Part 2 Ep20
programme.desc: Eren rejects Zeke, who only wishes to save him. The brothers learn the truth of their father, Grisha, along with the memories of that day.

programme.title: Attack on Titan Final Season Part 2 Ep21
programme.desc: Who started these 2,000 years of conflict and war? Eren speaks with Founder Ymir. 'I'm sure you've been waiting for someone... since 2,000 years ago.'

programme.title: Sword Oratoria: Is it Wrong to Try to Pick up Girls in a Dungeon? on the Side Ep1
programme.desc: Lefiya dreams of fighting in the dungeon beside someone she admires: Ais Wallenstein! When monsters attack the Loki Familia camp, will Lefiya be able to prove her worth?

programme.title: Sword Oratoria: Is it Wrong to Try to Pick up Girls in a Dungeon? on the Side Ep2
programme.desc: The members of the Loki Familia recover from their most recent adventure. After a long day of errands, they visit Loki's favorite tavern where Ais runs into a familiar face.

programme.title: Reborn as a Space Mercenary: I Woke up Piloting the Strongest Starship! Ep8
programme.desc: Takahiro 'Hiro' is reborn into his favourite game, commanding the best starship. He journeys across space as a mercenary to fulfil his dream of buying an expensive house with a garden.

programme.title: Full Clearing Another World Under a Goddess With Zero Believers Ep7
programme.desc: Makoto and his classmates are transported to another world, but he is the only weak one. Pairing up with a forgotten goddess, Noah, Makoto aims for the top using unorthodox methods, hardcore mode!

programme.title: Magical Explorer Ep9
programme.desc: Reborn in a dating sim as a comic-relief side character with unexpected hidden powers, Kousuke, armed with extensive knowledge of the game, seeks a happy ending with the heroines he admires.

programme.title: Call of Heroes / 危城
programme.desc: Set in 1914 following the collapse of the Qing dynasty, the action-packed Call of Heroes tells the story of a group of villagers standing up to a cruel young warlord to protect their homeland.

programme.title: Shadows / 殘影空間
programme.desc: Ching is a forensic psychiatrist who has the power to enter a person’s subconscious mind. In her latest case, she suspects that another psychiatrist is responsible for a brutal murder-cum-suicide case involving a social worker. In the investigation process, Ching finds herself under suspicion instead, as she comes face-to-face with a past trauma…

programme.title: Detective Dee and Nine-storey Demon Building / 狄仁傑之九層妖樓
programme.desc: A series of strange incidents happen at the Tang’s demon building but Detective Dee finds no clue. Dee finds the master of the family suspicious when he speaks with him, and when the eldest daughter Miss Tang secretly informs Dee about Mr Tang’s strange behavior and the fact that she is kept under surveillance, Dee vows to unveil the truth.

programme.title: Detective Chinatown 1900 / 唐探1900
programme.desc: In 1900s San Francisco, a white woman is murdered in Chinatown, and a Chinese man becomes the prime suspect. The crime sparks public outcry to shut down the district. Amid growing unrest, two Chinese detectives, Qin Fu and Ah Gui, race against time to uncover the true killer before prejudice and danger consume their community.

programme.title: The White Storm 2: Drug Lords / 掃毒2天地對決
programme.desc: Drug lord Jizo joins forces with Mexican cartels, throwing Hong Kong's drug underworld into chaos. Determined to eradicate narcotics, billionaire Yu Shun Tin offers a HK$100 million bounty on drug traffickers while concealing a dark bond with Jizo. As their shared past resurfaces, an explosive showdown becomes inevitable.

programme.title: The Invisible Guest / 瞞天過海
programme.desc: Young and beautiful entrepreneur Joanna is a prime suspect in a locked-room murder where her lover is found dead. She pays off a police officer to prove her innocence. During the investigation, they discover another murder case involving Joanna and her lover, and eventually reveals the truth.

programme.title: L Storm / L風暴
programme.desc: ICAC Chief Officer Luk and Chief Inspector Lau both hit a dead end when investigating their respective bribery and money laundering cases. When Luk is accused of bribery after being framed by the money launderers, he risks everything he has to find crucial evidence against them to clear his name.

programme.title: Seoul Raiders / 韓城攻略
programme.desc: A special agent from the Japanese National Security teams up with a skilled thief to find a pair of plates used to make counterfeit USD. However, a US Embassy representative appears and steals the plates, running away to Korea with them.

programme.title: Stand Up Story / 說笑之人
programme.desc: Mancer knows his father Wah is intellectually challenged since young and has to take care of him after his mother left them. When Mancer discovers and finds solace in stand-up comedy, he learns that hardships provide the best comedic material - from his own school ridicule experience to pandemic woes, misery can fuel laughter!

programme.title: Tales from the Occult: Ultimate Malevolence / 失衡兇間之惡念之最
programme.desc: The final chapter of 'Tales From The Occult', the movie features three short stories about two high school friends, a magician undergoing hypnosis to find her missing friend, and a man finding his way out of a mysterious building. The stories reveal the most terrifying and ugly side of human nature, where life and death are just a thought away!

programme.title: Sky on Fire / 沖天火
programme.desc: The chief security officer at a top-secret medical facility finds himself caught in an explosive battle when a young thief steals a groundbreaking medicine. After discovering the true origins of the medicine however, the officer must decide who he can trust to protect the cure from falling into the wrong hands and prevent an all-out war.

programme.title: Busted Water Pipes / 爆水管
programme.desc: With crime almost non-existent in town, the police face the axe. To save their jobs, officer Yu Da Hai stages a fake robbery for his team to heroically foil. Unbeknownst to him, a gang of tomb raiders is tunnelling towards buried treasure beneath the station. When a water pipe bursts, chaos erupts and the line between cops and crooks blurs.

programme.title: Possession Street / 邪Mall
programme.desc: When seven vengeful spirits turn the tenants of an abandoned mall into zombies, a video store owner, his daughter and a feng shui master must fight for survival. As the undead multiply and the evil spirits grow stronger, they race to stop the haunting before the entire mall descends into a living hell.

programme.title: My Country, My Parents / 我和我的父輩
programme.desc: Set in 4 different eras in China, the 4-part anthology about ‘home and country’ is directed by Wu Jing, Zhang Zi Yi, Xu Zheng and Shen Teng, who also star in their own story. The movie depicts how the ‘fathers’ forge ahead through the struggle of times, defending strong family ties and passing on the ‘fighting’ spirit through generations.

programme.title: Chilli Laugh Story / 闔家辣
programme.desc: Coba is forced to work at home during COVID-19 and fights with his family every day. He decides to turn his mother’s chilli sauce into a trendy commodity to keep his family occupied. With his mother, father and aunt making the chilli sauce together, the family sells it online and the business grows beyond their imagination.

programme.title: Kill Time / 謀殺似水年華
programme.desc: Mak stumbles upon an obscure website “Witch’s Zone” when looking for a copy of her dead father’s favorite song. The mysterious website only allows one purchase but Mak cannot resist buying one more purple scarf. Not only does the scarf triggers her memories of her father and her first love, it may also be a vital clue in a mysterious murder.

programme.title: Project Gutenberg / 無雙
programme.desc: Master counterfeiter Lee Man recounts his rise within a powerful criminal syndicate led by the mysterious “Painter,” whose forged banknotes are indistinguishable from real currency. As police close in, betrayal, deception, and hidden identities blur the line between truth and lies in a dangerous world of crime and manipulation.

programme.title: Ne Zha / 哪吒之魔童降世
programme.desc: Ne Zha is destined to save the nation with the power of the Spirit Seed. However, the Dragon King’s sinister plot to replace it with the Demon Pill transforms Ne Zha into a devil incarnate. Now, he must struggle between good and evil to break free from the chains of fate.

programme.title: We are Family / 出租家人
programme.desc: Struggling as an extra, Chi Kwong joins a rent-a-family company run by Carlos and aspiring actress Catherine, and rent themselves out as make-believe relatives. As they surrogate different families, they unravel the complexities of family relationships, forging deeper connections along the way.

programme.title: YOLO / 熱辣滾燙
programme.desc: Feeling lost and aimless, Le Ying chooses to withdraw from society after a short working experience. After a series of unexpected events one day, she decides to embrace life anew. She sees a chance for a fresh start when she meets a boxing coach, yet the challenges ahead far exceed her expectations, marking a vibrant start to her journey.

programme.title: A Writer's Odyssey II / 刺殺小說家2
programme.desc: Fallen novelist Lu Kong Wen is drawn into the fantasy world of his own novel, where a powerful villain awakens with self-awareness and plots to invade reality. Forced to join forces with his fictional heroes, Lu becomes caught in a cross-dimensional battle that will determine the fate of both worlds.

programme.title: Inexternal / 裡應外合
programme.desc: Veterinary assistant Zeming is pushed to the brink after a medical dispute. On the edge of life and death, he is drawn into a surreal realm of dreams and myth. Guided by a mysterious old man, he faces a brutal survival test, navigating illusion and reality in search of truth and awakening.

programme.title: Shadow / 影
programme.desc: In a time of war, the wounded Commander Zi Yu of Pei secretly appoints a double to serve as his shadow and rule in his place. With the help of his wife, he weaves a web of deception and ambition. But as power, identity, and desire intertwine, the shadow awakens to his own will, leading to a deadly confrontation between master and mirror.

programme.title: Ultimate Revenge / 火拼
programme.desc: A series of jewellery heists rocks the city. As task force leader Cheng Zhi Bun hunts the culprits, he discovers the gang leaders are the long-wanted Yuen brothers. Old scores and new grievances collide as team member Cheung Ka Wo, driven by his brother’s death, begins to unravel, and a brutal shootout uncovers a secret buried for years.

programme.title: If You are the One III / 非誠勿擾III
programme.desc: Qin Fen retires alone to a small island in 2031 while his wife Xiao Xiao works abroad for the past 10 years. Qin Fen misses Xiao Xiao very much, so his friend makes an intelligent robot in Xiao Xiao’s image to keep Qin company. As they begin to live happily, Xiao Xiao suddenly returns, and Qin Fen must now choose between the two “Xiao Xiao”

Not only does the scarf triggers her memories of her father and her first love, it may also be a vital clue in a mysterious murder.

programme.title: Project Gutenberg / 無雙
programme.desc: Master counterfeiter Lee Man recounts his rise within a powerful criminal syndicate led by the mysterious “Painter,” whose forged banknotes are indistinguishable from real currency. As police close in, betrayal, deception, and hidden identities blur the line between truth and lies in a dangerous world of crime and manipulation.

programme.title: Ne Zha / 哪吒之魔童降世
programme.desc: Ne Zha is destined to save the nation with the power of the Spirit Seed. However, the Dragon King’s sinister plot to replace it with the Demon Pill transforms Ne Zha into a devil incarnate. Now, he must struggle between good and evil to break free from the chains of fate.

programme.title: We are Family / 出租家人
programme.desc: Struggling as an extra, Chi Kwong joins a rent-a-family company run by Carlos and aspiring actress Catherine, and rent themselves out as make-believe relatives. As they surrogate different families, they unravel the complexities of family relationships, forging deeper connections along the way.

programme.title: YOLO / 熱辣滾燙
programme.desc: Feeling lost and aimless, Le Ying chooses to withdraw from society after a short working experience. After a series of unexpected events one day, she decides to embrace life anew. She sees a chance for a fresh start when she meets a boxing coach, yet the challenges ahead far exceed her expectations, marking a vibrant start to her journey.

programme.title: A Writer's Odyssey II / 刺殺小說家2
programme.desc: Fallen novelist Lu Kong Wen is drawn into the fantasy world of his own novel, where a powerful villain awakens with self-awareness and plots to invade reality. Forced to join forces with his fictional heroes, Lu becomes caught in a cross-dimensional battle that will determine the fate of both worlds.

programme.title: Inexternal / 裡應外合
programme.desc: Veterinary assistant Zeming is pushed to the brink after a medical dispute. On the edge of life and death, he is drawn into a surreal realm of dreams and myth. Guided by a mysterious old man, he faces a brutal survival test, navigating illusion and reality in search of truth and awakening.

programme.title: Shadow / 影
programme.desc: In a time of war, the wounded Commander Zi Yu of Pei secretly appoints a double to serve as his shadow and rule in his place. With the help of his wife, he weaves a web of deception and ambition. But as power, identity, and desire intertwine, the shadow awakens to his own will, leading to a deadly confrontation between master and mirror.

programme.title: Ultimate Revenge / 火拼
programme.desc: A series of jewellery heists rocks the city. As task force leader Cheng Zhi Bun hunts the culprits, he discovers the gang leaders are the long-wanted Yuen brothers. Old scores and new grievances collide as team member Cheung Ka Wo, driven by his brother’s death, begins to unravel, and a brutal shootout uncovers a secret buried for years.

programme.title: If You are the One III / 非誠勿擾III
programme.desc: Qin Fen retires alone to a small island in 2031 while his wife Xiao Xiao works abroad for the past 10 years. Qin Fen misses Xiao Xiao very much, so his friend makes an intelligent robot in Xiao Xiao’s image to keep Qin company. As they begin to live happily, Xiao Xiao suddenly returns, and Qin Fen must now choose between the two “Xiao Xiao”

programme.title: My Country, My Parents / 我和我的父輩
programme.desc: Set in 4 different eras in China, the 4-part anthology about ‘home and country’ is directed by Wu Jing, Zhang Zi Yi, Xu Zheng and Shen Teng, who also star in their own story. The movie depicts how the ‘fathers’ forge ahead through the struggle of times, defending strong family ties and passing on the ‘fighting’ spirit through generations.

programme.title: The Mystic Nine: Qing Shan Hai / 老九門之青山海棠
programme.desc: When the mysterious descendant of the Zhang family, Zhang Qi Shan, encounters the martial arts expert Er Yue Hong in Changsha, the two young heroes become acquainted and team up to confront the ruthless warlord Zuo Qian Zhi. They also uncover the truth behind the rumoured "monster", and protect the safety of the people of Changsha together.

programme.title: Forensic Medicine Song Ci / 大法醫宋慈系列之偷梁換柱
programme.desc: Tasked with absolving Wu's wrongful conviction, Song Ci races against time to unveil the real culprit within two days. With the enigmatic clues on a paper fan and a missing weapon, Song Ci draws closer to finding the culprit. However, an indictment hiding a conspiracy suddenly appears, leaving Song Ci speechless...

programme.title: Raid / 浴血無名川
programme.desc: Meng, a Volunteer Army platoon leader, is commissioned to rescue a platoon in captive. Through arduous trials, Meng teams up with another platoon leader, Du. They decide to contain the enemy's artillery supply to reduce casualties, and vow to dedicate themselves to fight against the foes for their people.

programme.title: Westbound Inn / 西行客棧
programme.desc: Seeking a tranquil existence, anti-Japanese patriot Zhui operates an inn on the outskirts of town. The daughter of his foe flees to his inn one day with a treasure box containing the secret to fight the Japanese bandits. Though Zhui can easily kill her, he sets aside his hatred aside to help Bai fight back and deliver the secret box safely.

programme.title: Hunting No Man's Land / 獵殺無人區
programme.desc: A fatal pursuit happens in a no mans land. Young Jin Yan accidentally captures the scene of a poacher attacking a cop, and the villains attack and injure him when they discover his act. As Jin tries to escape, they kidnap his sister as well. Jin and his sister must strive to escape from the villains and bring them to justice.

programme.title: A Man Called Hero / 中華英雄之風雲再起
programme.desc: Jin Ao battles with Wu Di to preserve the "Pride" martial arts skill, which he passes to Hero Hua before he dies. Hua, who is born under the curse of the Star of Loneliness, leaves his family to practise the martial arts skill for 20 years, but still fails to master it. Can Hua finally master the skill and defeats Wu Di to save his people?

programme.title: The Sniper / 鬼手神槍
programme.desc: In Jiang Cheng, the secretive Xi He Hall controls the city’s underworld while hunting its legendary former sniper, “Ghost Hand”, branded a traitor. When street hustler Lu Lan impersonates the infamous marksman to make a living, he is captured by the organisation’s deadliest assassin and drawn into a deadly conspiracy.

programme.title: Big Talk, God Catcher / 大話神捕
programme.desc: A female ghost is sighted at a bridge following the murder of a widow two weeks ago in Qiu Feng County. Inspector Guo is assigned to hunt down the ghost promptly. Upon investigation, Guo discovers a man named Xia Chong disguising himself as the female ghost, leading to the revelation of a peculiar murder case.

programme.title: Almost Human / 機械畫皮
programme.desc: A science maniac creates an advanced humanlike robot, which accidentally develops its own thinking. It takes on the appearance of Susan by evil technology, and approaches her boyfriend. Meanwhile, police officer Li investigates a series of mysterious murder cases. A battle between humans and robots is about to begin.

programme.title: Nie Yinniang / 聶隱娘之絕命刺殺
programme.desc: After the An Shi Rebellion, the An Shi rebels unite as Fei Yi Gang to attack Hebei. Meanwhile, the court appoints swordsmen of the martial arts world to form Chang Shui Gang to eliminate the rebels. Both gangs set up traps in Wei Bo and a deadly battle has just begun!

programme.title: The Thousand Faces of Fei Jia / 奇門飛甲
programme.desc: A young man Wang Xiao Xia resides in a small town with his blind father. His only desire is to cure his father's eye disease. One day, he encounters Shen Nan Er by chance and gets embroiled in a conspiracy. In his quest to heal his father's eyes, he goes to the Qi Yin Sect and finally unveils his hidden identity, which was concealed by his father.

programme.title: Intra Game Robbery / 局中劫
programme.desc: While hotpot restaurants thrive in Hong Kong, a young man taking over his father's hotpot business faces tough times ahead. He remains resilient and insists on keeping all his staffs, hoping for a turnaround. When gangsters hold his staffs, customers and fiancée hostage in the restaurant one day, he vows to fight back and bring them to justice.

programme.title: King Serpent Island / 蛇王島
programme.desc: A greedy property developer bribes a snake catcher gang to eradicate serpents on King Serpent Island for profit. Meanwhile, the snake clan's descendant and two animal protection experts venture to the island to confirm the existence of the legendary Titan Snake, resulting in a fierce battle with the ruthless gang to preserve the island's ecology.

programme.title: Shao Xia Kuai Pao / 少俠快跑
programme.desc: In the Southern Song era, a young master and staff at Fei Yun inn aid General Li Xian Zhong to recover the lost territory in a northern expedition. However, Deputy General Shao's jealousy and sabotage cause the mission to fail. Fueled by anger, the team vows to capture Shao while helping the civilians to evacuate.

programme.title: Ghost Story / 聊齋新傳之畫皮人
programme.desc: Scholar Wang Sheng fortuitously rescues the fox demon Xiang Er and brings her home. Unaware of her identity, he falls in love with her, hoping for her to become his concubine. However, Xiang Er is manipulated by the old demoness to do evil and harm people. Will their paranormal love triumph over darkness, allowing them to live happily ever after?

programme.title: Dangerous Pursuit / 漠北追擊
programme.desc: Agula, a friend and coworker of Narcotic agent Yan, is killed by the drug dealer Chi Na. While Yan takes care of Agula's family, he encounters Chi Na who wants to flee the country with the help of Agula's father.

Armed with courage and ingenuity, Dee defeats the bloodthirsty vampires and ultimately exposes the prince’s dark ambitions.

programme.title: Robot Apocalypse
programme.desc: When expert hacker Tara tries to stop a powerful and sentient A.I. from taking over the world's military, the A.I. marks her as a terrorist who must be exterminated…

programme.title: Wusong VS Ximenqing
programme.desc: After uncovering his sister-in-law Pan Jin Lian’s affair with the corrupt Xi Men Qing, Wu Song is falsely accused and exiled. However, when his elder brother is murdered, Wu Song returns determined to seek justice. With the authorities refusing to punish the guilty, his fury drives him toward a bloody path of revenge.

programme.title: Detective Dee's Seven Deadly Sin

In his relentless pursuit of the truth, Detective Dee uncovers the mask of false righteousness and exposes the darkness hidden beneath.

programme.title: Five Shaolin Masters / 少林五祖
programme.desc: The Qing court plots to kill all Shaolin disciples by burning down Shaolin Temple. This sudden fire killed almost everyone except for five disciples. To take revenge on the Qing court, the five of them train hard in different fighting styles to become “The Five Shaolin Masters”.

programme.title: King Drummer / 青春鼓王
programme.desc: A young musician Chi Chiang is hired by the manager of a popular band when the group's drummer/leader Charlie, quits to join a rival group. The new drummer becomes an immediate hit, causing Charlie to be very jealous. Furthermore, the young drummer's mother is dead set against him having a music career.

programme.title: Heroes Shed No Tears / 英雄無淚
programme.desc: Kao Chien Fei is a young swordsman who wields a special sword with a teardrop marked on its blade. He is charged with averting an impending crisis in the martial arts world, but the villain, Zhou Tung Lai, wishes to become the ruler in the martial arts world, and launches a scheme to pit the various heroes against one another.

programme.title: Tropicana Interlude / 椰林春戀
programme.desc: Wealthy heir Ping Chien Jen spurns the family business for a travel agency with his girlfriend Su Yung Lan. While they are hosting visitors from Hong Kong, a student falls for Chien Jen, sparking tension. Consumed by jealousy, Yung Lan storms off, and the student crashes her car after learning of his engagement. Misunderstandings are eventually cleared, and happiness follows.

programme.title: The Iron Buddha / 鐵羅漢
programme.desc: After a notorious rapist Xiao kills his master and the entire clan, Han the last surviving disciple, decides to take revenge. He must find the legendary Hulong Blade to counter Xiao's Evil Poisonous Sword, but as Han has never seen Xiao before, he is deceived when Xiao poses as an ally to try and steal his Blade in the process.

programme.title: The Big Sting / 鬼馬神偷
programme.desc: Three buddies find a rare artifact known as the Double-Faced God but are poisoned by Lady Wu who steals the treasure from them. Before they die, they get their wives to promise to train their children to take back what is rightfully theirs. These kids grow up to exact a vengeance that turns out to be more hilarious than horrific in this comedy.

programme.title: Killers Five / 豪俠傳
programme.desc: The Duke’s daughter has been kidnapped by the notorious Golden Dragon Hill bandits. A swordman named Yue Zhen Bei is assigned to save her, and expecting many dangers on the journey, Yue garners help from a group of good friends who are also kung fu masters.

programme.title: The Butterfly Chalice / 蝴蝶盃
programme.desc: In the Ming Dynasty, scholar Tian Yu Chuan defends a fisherman’s honour but accidentally kills the governor’s son, driving him into exile. Pursued to the river’s edge, he is rescued by the fisherman’s daughter. Amid danger, love blossoms between them, and Tian seals their bond with his family heirloom, the Butterfly Chalice.

programme.title: The Proud Youth / 笑傲江湖
programme.desc: Ling Hu Chong, a Huashan clan’s disciple, is assigned to find the successor to the score “The Proud One”. Ling identifies Ying for the score but finds out that she is the daughter of the evil clan’s leader. At the same time, he is unwittingly dragged into an epic power struggle between clans, with complicated allegiances and perplexing moralities.

programme.title: Sweet And Wild / 野姑娘
programme.desc: Fang is a spunky young village girl who is not afraid to fight back against hooligans. She gets into trouble with the biggest hoodlum Tong when she foils his plans with a maid, causing Tong to plot a revenge. Luckily a man whom she is attracted to, Hai, comes in time to her rescue. Can they fight back?

programme.title: The Reckless Cricket / 奇門怪招爛頭蟀
programme.desc: Inspired by “Drunken Master”, this kung fu comedy features a bumbling martial artist creating a cricket-style fighting arts to fight and defeat the different martial artists who have beaten him before.

programme.title: The Last Tempest / 瀛台泣血
programme.desc: This sequel to The Empress Dowager continues the tale of Emperor Guangxu and Empress Dowager Cixi. Despite Guangxu’s enthronement, his ability to rule effectively is overshadowed by the ever-present power of Cixi. When his attempts to reform the Imperial system are thwarted by the Empress Dowager, Guangxu attempts to curb her power.

programme.title: The Land of Many Perfumes / 女兒國
programme.desc: Monk Tang San Zang, Monkey, Pigsy and Sha Wu Jing find themselves in Womanland, where women only give birth to baby girls and do so by drinking the magical spring water.

programme.title: Melody of Love / 包剪石沓
programme.desc: Three young doctors pursue three hard-to-get beauties in this romantic film set in the 70s “a-go-go” era. They have no idea where to start and use Rock-paper-scissor method to match themselves with the girls. The tactics and tricks they use are hilarious and they have to reshuffle their plans when nothing leads to success!

programme.title: The Big Sting / 鬼馬神偷
programme.desc: Three buddies find a rare artifact known as the Double-Faced God but are poisoned by Lady Wu who steals the treasure from them. Before they die, they get their wives to promise to train their children to take back what is rightfully theirs. These kids grow up to exact a vengeance that turns out to be more hilarious than horrific in this comedy.

programme.title: Killers Five / 豪俠傳
programme.desc: The Duke’s daughter has been kidnapped by the notorious Golden Dragon Hill bandits. A swordman named Yue Zhen Bei is assigned to save her, and expecting many dangers on the journey, Yue garners help from a group of good friends who are also kung fu masters.

programme.title: The Butterfly Chalice / 蝴蝶盃
programme.desc: In the Ming Dynasty, scholar Tian Yu Chuan defends a fisherman’s honour but accidentally kills the governor’s son, driving him into exile. Pursued to the river’s edge, he is rescued by the fisherman’s daughter. Amid danger, love blossoms between them, and Tian seals their bond with his family heirloom, the Butterfly Chalice.

programme.title: The Proud Youth / 笑傲江湖
programme.desc: Ling Hu Chong, a Huashan clan’s disciple, is assigned to find the successor to the score “The Proud One”. Ling identifies Ying for the score but finds out that she is the daughter of the evil clan’s leader. At the same time, he is unwittingly dragged into an epic power struggle between clans, with complicated allegiances and perplexing moralities.

programme.title: Sweet And Wild / 野姑娘
programme.desc: Fang is a spunky young village girl who is not afraid to fight back against hooligans. She gets into trouble with the biggest hoodlum Tong when she foils his plans with a maid, causing Tong to plot a revenge. Luckily a man whom she is attracted to, Hai, comes in time to her rescue. Can they fight back?

programme.title: The Reckless Cricket / 奇門怪招爛頭蟀
programme.desc: Inspired by “Drunken Master”, this kung fu comedy features a bumbling martial artist creating a cricket-style fighting arts to fight and defeat the different martial artists who have beaten him before.

programme.title: The Last Tempest / 瀛台泣血
programme.desc: This sequel to The Empress Dowager continues the tale of Emperor Guangxu and Empress Dowager Cixi. Despite Guangxu’s enthronement, his ability to rule effectively is overshadowed by the ever-present power of Cixi. When his attempts to reform the Imperial system are thwarted by the Empress Dowager, Guangxu attempts to curb her power.

programme.desc: Monk Tang San Zang, Monkey, Pigsy and Sha Wu Jing find themselves in Womanland, where women only give birth to baby girls and do so by drinking the magical spring water.

programme.title: Melody of Love / 包剪石沓
programme.desc: Three young doctors pursue three hard-to-get beauties in this romantic film set in the 70s “a-go-go” era. programme.title: The Wonder Shop (Home Shopping) - Karihome HMB Gold+ Goat Milk
programme.desc: An advanced adult goat milk formula featuring HMB to support muscle health, combined with premium goat milk, high-quality protein, prebiotic fibres, and over 35 essential nutrients. Naturally containing A2 β-casein and lower αs1-casein, it is gentle on digestion while supporting bone health and daily vitality. Specially formulated for adults and seniors to help maintain an active, healthy lifestyle. 特别添加 HMB，帮助维持肌肉健康；结合优质羊奶、优质蛋白、益生元膳食纤维及35种以上关键营养素，全方位支持肌肉、肠道、骨骼健康及每日活力。天然含A2 β-酪蛋白及较低αs1-酪蛋白，对肠胃较温和、较易消化。专为成年人及银发族配制，帮助维持健康、活力的生活方式。

programme.title: The Wonder Shop (Home Shopping) - Naturalle Sugar Care Tea
programme.desc: Crafted from 100% natural leaves including gymnema, mulberry and green tea, the Naturalle Sugar Care tea is mild-flavoured and low in calories. A perfect post-meal beverage, this tea may help curb sugar cravings and support healthy post-meal blood sugar levels, making it great for individuals who frequently consume carbohydrate-rich or sugary foods. Naturalle 糖适宁茶采用 100% 天然叶材精制而成，包括匙羹藤、桑叶与绿茶，口感清淡、低热量。糖适宁茶是适合餐后饮用，有助于抑制对甜食的渴望和维持血糖健康水平，非常适合经常摄取高碳水或含糖食物的人士饮用

programme.title: The Wonder Shop (Home Shopping) - Q'Sai Knee Supporter Collagen and Glucosamine

programme.desc: In late 1930s Latvia, young Bille grows up in poverty, caught between her mother’s contempt and her father’s alcoholism. Escaping into books and her imagination, she dreams of a better world as she embarks on her path to becoming a celebrated writer.

programme.title: King of Devil's Island
programme.desc: Norwegian winter, early 20th century. On the boys’ home Bastoy, a new inmate leads the boys to a violent uprising against a brutal regime. How far is he willing to go to attain freedom? Based on a true story.

programme.title: Temporaries
programme.desc: Ariane gets a job as an interpreter at a food plant after moving back to the Richelieu Valley following a breakup. There, she finds herself torn between obeying the harsh demands of her boss and standing up for the exploited migrant workers she befriends.

programme.title: Time For Love
programme.desc: Mikolaj jumps on a train smitten by a beautiful woman. But he is without a ticket. With the aid of charming Edyta, he tries to control the chaos on the train and in his life. Will this journey be enough to find love before Christmas?

programme.title: Not Here To Be Loved
programme.desc: Jean-Claude is a disillusioned middle-age man who has long forgotten to smile. He is divorced, has a strained relationship with his only son and thinks his father never loved him. Then, he steps in to a tango school and meets Francoise and life changes.

programme.title: A Murder Of Crows Jealousy
programme.desc: Inspector Bruhl is investigating the abduction of a young boy from a playground, until evidence suggests that the boy doesn’t exist at all. Is he a figment of the alleged mother’s fractured reality, or are answers buried in her traumatic past?

programme.title: Free Money
programme.desc: Based on true stories of the crypto and investment craze of the early 2020-ies. Crypto's allure, wealth's pursuit, and the lessons of a changing financial world collide in an intense journey of three interconnected lives - an unwitting Bitcoin holder, a crypto entrepreneur and a conservative banker.

programme.title: Detour
programme.desc: Law student Harper suspects his stepdad of causing the accident that sent his mother into a coma. After drowning his sorrows at a seedy bar one night, he wakes up to the realization that he may have hired a hitman and his girlfriend to kill his stepdad.

programme.title: Winners
programme.desc: 11-year-old Mona, a Syrian refugee in Berlin, struggles to adapt to her new life. When she joins a competitive girls' football team, she faces the challenge of being an outsider. Soon she realizes the value of teamwork for success.

programme.title: Catch The Wind
programme.desc: Edith is a middle-aged woman, estranged from her son and now about to lose her job as a textile factory worker. With nothing to hold her to her hometown, she decides to move to Morocco where her factory has relocated instead of facing unemployment.

programme.title: Veins Of The World
programme.desc: After his father dies in a tragic car accident, 11-year-old Amra sets out to continue his father’s vision of the traditional nomad way of life and to continue his fight against global mining companies who threaten to destroy it.

programme.title: A Murder Of Crows The Detective And The Fear
programme.desc: When Inspector Martin Brühl awakens in the morning, he is alarmed by partner Susanne Koch’s absence. Unbeknownst to him, Susanne witnessed a crime on her nightly walk home. Critically injured in an ATM explosion, she was kidnapped by the perpetrators.

programme.title: Love At First Fight
programme.desc: Between his friends and the family business, Arnaud's summer looks set to be a peaceful one. Peaceful until he runs into Madeleine, as beautiful as she is brusque, a concrete block of tensed muscles and doomsday prophecies.

programme.title: Two of a Kind
programme.desc: What if your long-lost twin was your complete opposite? Sparks fly when a struggling handyman and a privileged politician discover they share identical DNA and one is black, the other is white! Culture clashes and chaos erupt. How did this happen?

The squirrels decide it is time to tidy up. Luckily Duggee has his Organising Badge, and with the help of the Squirrels they reorganize everything in the clubhouse. Once finished they head outside... but how best to organise the animals?

programme.title: Hey Duggee S02 - The Grandparents Badge - EP 41

programme.title: Hey Duggee's Squirrel Club S01 - Night And Day - EP 14
programme.desc: Have you ever wondered what goes on at the Squirrel Club when the sun goes down?

programme.title: Bluey S02 - Grandad - EP 50
programme.desc: Grandad is supposed to be resting, but when Bluey and Bingo go to visit him, he makes a run for it with the kids and takes them on a madcap adventure into the bush.

programme.desc: Bora and Brody get Pio to show feverish Finn how a kangaroos in the Australian outback keep cool in the heat.

programme.title: Bebefinn: The Big Animal World S01 - Albatross, Bird that Rides the Wind - EP 4
programme.desc: Everyone learns about the gliding bird that is the Albatross. It soars without flapping it's wings! But how?!

programme.title: Andy's Baby Animal Missions S01 - Andy and the Puma Cubs - EP 3
programme.desc: Andy, Jen & Scout head to Patagonia, in South America on a baby animal mission in search of mother puma and her four cubs.

programme.title: Teletubbies S01 - Not Enough Room - EP 66
programme.desc: The Teletubbies are about to go on the Tubby Custard Ride with the hat, bag, ball and scooter when they realise there is not enough room. The Noo-­Noo looks after their things.

programme.title: Yakka Dee S04 - Juice - EP 14

programme.title: Messy goes to OKIDO S01 - Gills - EP 14
programme.desc: Messy wants to know how his goldfish friend can stay underwater for so long. He goes to OKIDO to find out.

programme.title: Bluey S03 - Perfect - EP 14

Chilli tries to convince Bluey that perfection isn't easy, or absolutely necessary.

programme.title: Bluey S03 - Pass the Parcel - EP 13

programme.title: Hey Duggee S05 - The Carrot Badge - EP 1

programme.title: Hey Duggee S05 - The Metal Detector Badge - EP 10

programme.desc: This side-splitting comedy sees naive Ah Niu headed to Hong Kong, where he is repeatedly exploited and taken advantage of, and eventually finds himself arrested and imprisoned! Can he survive difficult times and finally overcome adversity?

programme.desc: The Qing court plots to kill all Shaolin disciples by burning down Shaolin Temple. This sudden fire killed almost everyone except for five disciples. To take revenge on the Qing court, the five of them train hard in different fighting styles to become “The Five Shaolin Masters”.

programme.title: King Drummer
programme.desc: A young musician Chi Chiang is hired by the manager of a popular band when the group's drummer/leader Charlie, quits to join a rival group. The new drummer becomes an immediate hit, causing Charlie to be very jealous. Furthermore, the young drummer's mother is dead set against him having a music career.

programme.title: Heroes Shed No Tears
programme.desc: Kao Chien Fei is a young swordsman who wields a special sword with a teardrop marked on its blade. He is charged with averting an impending crisis in the martial arts world, but the villain, Zhou Tung Lai, wishes to become the ruler in the martial arts world, and launches a scheme to pit the various heroes against one another.

programme.title: Tropicana Interlude
programme.desc: Wealthy heir Ping Chien Jen spurns the family business for a travel agency with his girlfriend Su Yung Lan. While they are hosting visitors from Hong Kong, a student falls for Chien Jen, sparking tension. Consumed by jealousy, Yung Lan storms off, and the student crashes her car after learning of his engagement. Misunderstandings are eventually cleared, and happiness follows.

programme.title: The Iron Buddha
programme.desc: After a notorious rapist Xiao kills his master and the entire clan, Han the last surviving disciple, decides to take revenge. He must find the legendary Hulong Blade to counter Xiao's Evil Poisonous Sword, but as Han has never seen Xiao before, he is deceived when Xiao poses as an ally to try and steal his Blade in the process.

programme.title: The Big Sting
programme.desc: Three buddies find a rare artifact known as the Double-Faced God but are poisoned by Lady Wu who steals the treasure from them. Before they die, they get their wives to promise to train their children to take back what is rightfully theirs. These kids grow up to exact a vengeance that turns out to be more hilarious than horrific in this comedy.

programme.title: Killers Five
programme.desc: The Duke's daughter has been kidnapped by the notorious Golden Dragon Hill bandits. A swordman named Yue Zhen Bei is assigned to save her, and expecting many dangers on the journey, Yue garners help from a group of good friends who are also kung fu masters.

programme.title: The Butterfly Chalice
programme.desc: In the Ming Dynasty, scholar Tian Yu Chuan defends a fisherman's honour but accidentally kills the governor's son, driving him into exile. Pursued to the river's edge, he is rescued by the fisherman's daughter. Amid danger, love blossoms between them, and Tian seals their bond with his family heirloom, the Butterfly Chalice.

programme.title: The Proud Youth
programme.desc: Ling Hu Chong, a Huashan clan's disciple, is assigned to find the successor to the score “The Proud One”. Ling identifies Ying for the score but finds out that she is the daughter of the evil clan's leader. At the same time, he is unwittingly dragged into an epic power struggle between clans, with complicated allegiances and perplexing moralities.

programme.title: Sweet And Wild
programme.desc: Fang is a spunky young village girl who is not afraid to fight back against hooligans. She gets into trouble with the biggest hoodlum Tong when she foils his plans with a maid, causing Tong to plot a revenge. Luckily a man whom she is attracted to, Hai, comes in time to her rescue. Can they fight back?

programme.title: The Reckless Cricket
programme.desc: Inspired by “Drunken Master”, this kung fu comedy features a bumbling martial artist creating a cricket-style fighting arts to fight and defeat the different martial artists who have beaten him before.

programme.title: The Last Tempest
programme.desc: This sequel to The Empress Dowager continues the tale of Emperor Guangxu and Empress Dowager Cixi. Despite Guangxu's enthronement, his ability to rule effectively is overshadowed by the ever-present power of Cixi. When his attempts to reform the Imperial system are thwarted by the Empress Dowager, Guangxu attempts to curb her power.

programme.title: The Land of Many Perfumes
programme.desc: Monk Tang San Zang, Monkey, Pigsy and Sha Wu Jing find themselves in Womanland, where women only give birth to baby girls and do so by drinking the magical spring water.

programme.title: Melody of Love
programme.desc: Three young doctors pursue three hard-to-get beauties in this romantic film set in the 70s “a-go-go” era. They have no idea where to start and use Rock-paper-scissor method to match themselves with the girls. The tactics and tricks they use are hilarious and they have to reshuffle their plans when nothing leads to success!

programme.title: Melody of Love
programme.desc: Three young doctors pursue three hard-to-get beauties in this romantic film set in the 70s “a-go-go” era. They have no idea where to start and use Rock-paper-scissor method to match themselves with the girls. The tactics and tricks they use are hilarious and they have to reshuffle their plans when nothing leads to success!

programme.title: The Brave Archer
programme.desc: On his way back to the midlands, Guo Jing meets Huang Rong and they quickly fall in love. However, Ouyang Ke proposes to marry Huang Rong at the same time, so Huang's father sets up a duel for the two men to compete for her hand. Guo Jing finally beats Ouyang Ke to win Huang Rong back.

programme.title: The Shepherd Girl
programme.desc: In this musical drama, Hsiu Hsiu, a beautiful shepherd girl, falls in love with a handsome boatman Ta Lung. However, she cannot afford to marry him because of her father's towering debt from gambling. To complicate the matter, a rival suitor promises to pay off all her father's debts on one condition: that Hsiu Hsiu marries him...

programme.title: Super Inframan
programme.desc: Transformed from a young laboratory researcher, the thunderbolt-fisted Inframan must battle Princess Dragon Mom who wakes up from hibernation to conquer the earth with her army of mutant monsters.

programme.desc: Fang Ming marries the mysterious young lady Leng Qiu Ping, only to discover she is a spirit forced to drain men's life essence. With a Taoist's help, he frees her from an evil force, but their love cannot cross life and death, and they part at dawn in a bittersweet farewell.

programme.title: The Heroic Ones
programme.desc: Set in the Tang Dynasty, the 13 adopted sons of Sha Tuo King are all renowned as royal warriors. David Chiang plays the 13th Prince, a powerful fighter whose prestigious status provokes jealously, leading to a gruesome family feud.

programme.title: The Anonymous Heroes
programme.desc: Carefree drifters Meng Gang and Tie Hu discover their purpose after meeting the revolutionary leader, Wan Tai. With the help of Meng Gang's girlfriend, they infiltrate a warlord camp to seize weapons for the revolutionary cause. Following a fierce battle, all three make the ultimate sacrifice, becoming the "Anonymous Heroes" of the revolution.

programme.title: Swordsman at Large
programme.desc: Hsiao Shi Yi Lang is the Swordsman at large who everyone wants to kill. A magnificient sword is even created for this purpose though the blade is soon coveted more than the swordsman's death by it! Bandits, beauties and blade masters battle for survival in this exciting story of deceit, betrayal, and death.

programme.title: The Protectors
programme.desc: Ling Hsiao and Kuan Wang Lung are two guard chiefs working for an old convoy master. Lung is secretly in love with Fang Yen, the master's granddaughter but Yen is attracted to Ling Hsiao instead. In order to win her back, Lung sets up a trap to steal the convoy and frames Ling Hsiao for it.

programme.title: Tragic Commitment
programme.desc: When the husband of a doctor, Tung is fatally wounded in an accident, he reveals to her about his affair with Blackie, who is impregnated with his baby. Despite the devastation of the betrayal and the eventual death of her husband, Tung is pressured by her mother-in-law into putting up with Blackie and offer $1M for her baby...

programme.title: Trilogy Of Swordsmanship
programme.desc: A kung fu anthology film consisting of three stories: a man embarrasses himself while trying to prove his worth to the father of the woman he loves; a courtesan in love with a general will need to deliver a notorious bandit in exchange for him not being executed; and a group of bandits forms a plan to rescue a new friend from being executed.

programme.title: The Bells of Death
programme.desc: Wei Fu is an unremarkable woodcutter. However, when psychotic marauders killed his family and abducted his sister, he goes through vigorous martial arts training with an expert swordsman in order to exact revenge on the evildoers.

programme.title: The Supreme Swordsman
programme.desc: After beating several famous swordsmen, Chin Wu Hsin of the Mo Shan clan challenges Supreme Swordsman to a duel, hoping to win his title, and is beaten and humiliated. The winner taunts him to find a Supreme Sword made by Old Eagle, a famous sword-maker. When his offer to buy a sword from Old Eagle, is turned down, he challenges Old Eagle to a duel, and snatches his sword in a foul play. Old Eagle's own son Shih Yen-peh vows to avenge for his father...

programme.title: A Friend from Inner Space
programme.desc: A young boy whose parents are separated tries to find happiness in life. One day, he meets and befriends a kind-hearted spirit Ren, who decides to make him truly happy by getting his parents back together.

programme.title: Shaolin Prince
programme.desc: Two royal brothers are separated as babies after a traitorous general usurps the throne. Raised apart, one within Shaolin Temple and the other by a noble lord, they grow into formidable martial artists. When destiny reunites them, the brothers must combine their deadly kung fu styles to overthrow the tyrant and avenge their fallen empire.

programme.title: Shaolin Prince
programme.desc: Two royal brothers are separated as babies after a traitorous general usurps the throne. Raised apart, one within Shaolin Temple and the other by a noble lord, they grow into formidable martial artists. When destiny reunites them, the brothers must combine their deadly kung fu styles to overthrow the tyrant and avenge their fallen empire.

programme.title: The Younger Generation
programme.desc: A tragic tale about a young girl who gets married and has five kids. When she and her husband die, leaving all five kids behind to fend for themselves, the eldest child is forced to be sold into prostitution to feed the other four.

programme.title: The Silent Swordsman
programme.desc: Young swordsman Shen Bing Yi is appointed leader of the "Sun and Moon" secret society, sworn to take down a traitorous general conspiring with foreign invaders. While fighting for his nation, he captures the hearts of a spirited female warrior and two beautiful Uyghur princesses, leaving him caught between his duty and their devotion.

programme.title: My Dream Boat
programme.desc: This is a story about the complicated love relationships between a group of young friends who are entangled in a web of love and emotions.
